title: A line saved before this change opens with the same title and description
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15102) was created before the What/Why change reached this build and has a line {Line-1} (for example "Replace - Brake pot").
  • {Line-1}'s title and description were written down before the change reached this build (for example from a screenshot), as {Title-A} (for example Replace - Brake pot) and {Description-A} (for example pads at 2mm).
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Read {Line-1}'s title and description in the list.
  3. Click {Line-1}'s title to open Edit Line.
  4. Read the Title and Description fields.
  5. Close the window without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Line-1} shows exactly {Title-A} and {Description-A}.
  • Step 4: Title shows exactly {Title-A} and Description shows exactly {Description-A}, character for character, with no question text added in front of either.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S1-N1, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.5 (Edit Line - after), 13 Oct copy; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1: “No existing line is altered. The rename is on the labels, not on the data.”
  • SV-10130 acceptance criteria: “Given a line created before this change, when it is opened, then its title and description values are exactly as they were saved.”
